final_source_surface.kind: sha256 of git diff --binary for the reusable template, bootstrap wrapper, demo-graph smoke, and operator manifest

commands.result: The existing bootstrap checks passed, but acceptance review found that the source graph had no PRD and therefore could not satisfy Test 6's explicit fresh-agent PRD coverage requirement. This run was not accepted as Test 6 proof.

commands.command: mdkg --root examples/website-demo-template new prd "Reusable static Astro website demo platform" --tags website-demo,static-astro,source-template --json
commands.result: The CLI allocated prd-2, which was preserved without renumbering and then authored as the reusable source requirements.
Failed closed with manifest_source_hash_mismatch after an adjacent manifest hash was edited incorrectly; the correct AGENTS.md hash was restored and no run directory was retained.
The fork and 13-node pack succeeded, then the smoke failed because its expected node-count assertion still required 12. The stale assertion was corrected.
Absent-target creation, PRD-aware packs, repeat equality, five negative cases, validation, routing, source-index immutability, and cleanup passed.
Final structured-receipt rerun passed with the inventory hash and full pack QID list emitted.
